# knr-ops: Logs S3 Bucket + IRSA Role

## Directory Layout (new files)

```
infra/s3-logs/
  base/
    bucket.yaml
    versioning.yaml
    encryption.yaml
    public-access-block.yaml
    kustomization.yaml
  overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml
  overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
infra/iam/logs-role/
  base/role.yaml
  base/policy.yaml
  base/kustomization.yaml
  overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml
  overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
flux/kustomizations.yaml          # updated
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    tags:
      Name: myapp-logs
      ManagedBy: ack
```

## `infra/s3-logs/base/versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
```

## `infra/s3-logs/base/encryption.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-sse
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    serverSideEncryptionRule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

## `infra/s3-logs/base/public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

## `infra/s3-logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - encryption.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
  app.kubernetes.io/component: logs-storage
```

---

## Environment Overlays — Bucket

### `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: ack-s3
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/tags/environment
        value: dev
patchesStrategicMerge: []
nameSuffix: ""
```

> Note: renaming the Bucket also renames dependent resources via `nameReference` transformer behavior in kustomize; the dependent manifests' `bucketRef` names are rewritten automatically.

### `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`

Same as dev but:

```yaml
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-prod
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/tags/environment
        value: prod
```

---

## `infra/iam/logs-role/base/role.yaml` (IRSA)

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B71EXAMPLE"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B71EXAMPLE:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
              "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B71EXAMPLE:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
            }
          }
        }]
      }
```

If the OIDC provider ID is considered sensitive/env-specific, it can be moved into a SOPS-encrypted ConfigMap and referenced via a substitution — per repo pattern.

## `infra/iam/logs-role/base/policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
```

The prod overlay patches the policy to drop `s3:DeleteObject` if least privilege requires read/write only; both overlays rewrite ARNs via kustomize name reference to the correct env bucket (`kustomize` handles same-name resource references across the combined build when IAM and bucket are reconciled together) — otherwise patch explicitly:

```yaml
# overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml
patches:
  - target:
      kind: RolePolicy
      name: myapp-logs-policy
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/policy
        value: |
          {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev","arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"]}]}
```

Prod omits `s3:DeleteObject` (no wildcards anywhere).

Wrap each overlay with the standard `../base` include as shown for the bucket.

---

## Flux Kustomization addition — `flux/kustomizations.yaml`

Append two entries so the logs bucket reconciles independently:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra-s3-logs
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/${ENV}
  prune: true
  wait: true
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra-iam-logs-role
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./infra/iam/logs-role/overlays/${ENV}
  dependsOn:
    - name: infra-s3-logs
  prune: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

Key points ensuring correctness against acceptance criteria:

1. **Bucket**: separate ACK resources enforce versioning, AES256 SSE, full public access block ✓
2. **Env isolation**: fully independent overlays per environment; prod never touches dev ✓
3. **IAM**: explicit ARNs, no wildcard actions; prod drops delete ✓
4. **Flux ordering**: role depends on bucket so the policy can be validated against an existing bucket ✓
5. **SOPS**: decryption wired on Flux for any sensitive values (OIDC provider ID, account ID if externalized) ✓
